course.title: Astrophysics II: Stellar Structure and Evolution
course.description: Develops the physics of stellar interiors, opacity, energy transport, nuclear burning, stellar atmospheres, main sequence evolution, late-stage evolution, compact remnants, supernovae, and nucleosynthesis.

status.reviewStatus: Approved for review release; not yet approved for instructional use

cadence.rationale: Matched 1:1 biweekly cadence, directly following the ASTR310 precedent (itself following ASTR210's 4-credit, 14-lecture structure and ASTR230's matched-cadence pattern), because ASTR330's units build one cumulative toolkit (structure equations, opacity/transport, nuclear burning, mass-luminosity-lifetime scaling, post-main-sequence evolution, compact-object physics) toward a single capstone (Lab/PS 07, PSR J0348+0432). See syllabus.html Lecture, Lab, and Problem-Set Cadence.

dataProvenance.src: materials/ASTR330/src/generate_astr330_content.py and generate_astr330_labs_psets.py generate all worked examples, lecture slides/notes, labs, and problem sets programmatically from shared constants.
realData: Hyades open cluster distance, age, main-sequence turnoff mass, total mass, and structural radii (core/half-mass/tidal radii) and metallicity - live-verified via direct web fetch this session (Wikipedia "Hyades (star cluster)", citing Perryman et al. 1998, A&A 331, 81).

PSR J0348+0432 neutron star mass and radius, white dwarf companion mass and radius, and the pulsar-white dwarf binary's orbital period, semimajor axis, and inclination - live-verified via direct web fetch this session (Wikipedia "PSR J0348+0432", citing Antoniadis et al. 2013, Science 340, 1233232).
Alpha Centauri A and B stellar parameters (Lectures 06, 07) - carried forward with established provenance (live-verified in ASTR310's production, citing Akeson et al. 2021, AJ 162, 14).

Sirius A parameters (Lectures 06, 07) and Sirius B parameters (Lectures 11, 12, 13, 14) - carried forward with established provenance (Sirius B live-verified in ASTR230's production, citing Bond et al. 2017, ApJ 840, 70; Sirius A a standard published Hipparcos-era value, carried forward from ASTR310, not independently re-verified this session).

Standard solar-model core density, temperature, and central pressure (Lectures 01-04) - standard published values, not independently re-verified this session, carried forward from ASTR310 - flagged for spot-check.

Standard nuclear saturation density and typical core-collapse supernova observed kinetic/radiated energy (Lecture 13/14) - standard published values, not independently re-verified this session - flagged for spot-check.
